recommendations.title: Recommended for you
recommendations.context: Top picks with high Retention Scores (you'll finish them) and solid MAL Satisfaction (they're actually good).

help.title: How We Pick Recommendations
help.intro: Our recommendation algorithm balances two key factors:

retention.title: Retention Score (60%)
retention.description: How likely you are to finish the series. Based on watch-through patterns.

satisfaction.title: Satisfaction Score (40%)
satisfaction.description: Community rating from MyAnimeList. Represents overall quality.

help.note: This combination helps find anime that's both engaging and high-quality.

balanced.label: Balanced
balanced.context: Retention-first picks blended with MAL satisfaction for more dependable recommendations.

binge.label: Binge Mode
binge.description: High retention, hard to stop watching
binge.context: Shows that are hard to stop watching - high flow state and strong hooks.

quality.label: Critical Acclaim
quality.context: Top-rated by the community - focus on critical acclaim and satisfaction.

discovery.label: Hidden Gems
discovery.context: Hidden gems with high retention but lower mainstream popularity.

comfort.label: Comfort Shows
comfort.context: Easy, stress-free shows perfect for relaxing and unwinding.

catalog.title: Browse the catalog
catalog.subtitle: Explore all titles, sorted by what matters to you.

noResults.title: No matches yet
noResults.description: Try removing a filter or two—there might be a hidden gem waiting.

notFound.descriptionDeepLink: We couldn't find the anime you're looking for. It may have been removed or the ID is incorrect.

detail.retentionScoreTooltip: How consistently people keep watching across episodes. Factors in strong starts, low drop-off, and steady pacing.
detail.strongStartTooltip: How compelling the first 3 episodes are. High scores mean the show hooks viewers early.
detail.keepsYouWatchingTooltip: Low drop-off probability. Measures how likely viewers are to continue without losing interest.
detail.finishPayoffTooltip: How well the show sticks the landing. Combines finale strength, momentum, and narrative build-up.

retentionScore.title: Retention Score (0-100)
retentionScore.label: Retention Score
retentionScore.shortDesc: How consistently viewers watch through the entire series
retentionScore.fullDesc: Measures how likely you are to finish the entire series without dropping off. Based on episode-by-episode analysis of viewer behavior.

satisfactionScore.title: Satisfaction Score (MAL)
satisfactionScore.label: Satisfaction (MAL)
satisfactionScore.fullDesc: Overall quality rating from the MyAnimeList community. Represents how much viewers enjoyed the anime overall.

welcome.title: Welcome to Rekonime
welcome.description: Find anime you'll actually finish. We analyze watch-through patterns to recommend shows that stay engaging from start to finish.

retention.title: Understanding Retention Score
retention.description: Our signature metric: a 0-100 scale measuring how consistently viewers watch through an entire series without dropping off.
retention.highRetentionDesc: Most viewers finish the whole series

satisfaction.title: Understanding Satisfaction
satisfaction.description: Community ratings from MyAnimeList (MAL), the world's largest anime database. This represents overall quality and enjoyment.
